nodes.label: Canonical Neutral Location Plate
nodes.rationale: One neutral low-oblique plate should own stable visual geometry, projection, roads, doors, yards, gates, and paths; full alternate plates are reserved for large physical changes because generated variants drift in topology and sprite scale.

nodes.label: Runtime Masks, Sockets, Overlays, and Actor Stack
nodes.rationale: Time, weather, season, occupancy, props, characters, creatures, lights, smoke, and events belong in aligned masks, typed sockets, decals, particles, sprites, and color grades over the canonical plate, with a defined render order and minimum production bundle.
